**ROLE SUMMARY**

You will be a core contributor on a five-person engineering team building the internal tooling that speeds up our design-to-construction pipeline. Your main focus is our CAD automation platform: a system that generates and validates complex 3D assemblies programmatically, so our mechanical designers and engineers can iterate far faster than traditional CAD workflows allow. You will integrate AI tools into this workflow, solve hard geometry and data modeling problems, and own major parts of the software stack end to end. Success in the first 90 days looks like design automation pipelines our engineers rely on daily and a construction schedule that stays on track because of them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop and maintain our in-house CAD automation pipeline, which is a part of our ATLAS platform. This pipeline generates parametric 3D assemblies (geometry, tolerances, bill of materials) from structured design inputs.
* Build software interfaces between our design toolchain and standard engineering formats (STEP, IGES, manufacturing packages) for handoff to construction and fabrication partners.
* Automate physics simulation workflows: pipelines that set up runs (Monte Carlo neutronics, electromagnetic solvers, thermal analysis, parameter sweeps), queue them on our compute, parse solver output, and feed results back into design iteration. Today much of this is manual; your job is to make it push-button.
* Own core pieces of ATLAS, our multi-agent AI platform: orchestration and agent delegation, retrieval over engineering and regulatory document corpora, tool gateways, and evaluation and tracing so we can trust what the system produces.
* Build the design task management layer that connects individual engineering tasks to the master construction schedule, with dependency tracking and two-way sync to our project management tools.
* Contribute to internal tooling infrastructure: version control for design artifacts, automated validation and consistency checking, and documentation generation.
* Collaborate daily with mechanical designers and nuclear engineers: translate physical constraints into software logic, and surface software capabilities that open up new design approaches.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* Strong software engineering fundamentals: Python and/or TypeScript, clean architecture, version control, testing.
* **Hands-on experience integrating frontier AI models into production workflows**
  : model APIs, agentic systems (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar), retrieval and context management, evals, observability, and the surrounding infrastructure required to deploy reliable AI-enabled products.
* Experience building tools used by domain experts (engineers, scientists, designers). You know how to translate expert knowledge into reliable software.
* Comfort working with geometry, spatial data, or engineering file formats (CAD, STEP, mesh, simulation outputs).
* Track record of shipping in resource-constrained environments: startup, early-stage team, or solo ownership of a complex system.
* Excellent communication with non-software collaborators. You can explain a technical constraint to a mechanical engineer and absorb domain knowledge quickly.
* High agency: you identify problems, propose solutions, and execute without needing a detailed spec.

**Preferred**

* Experience as an early technical hire at a deep-tech, hardware, or engineering-software startup.
* Production infrastructure experience: AWS, Docker, Postgres.
* Background in or exposure to mechanical engineering, manufacturing, or technical design review processes.
* Experience with CAD systems (OpenCascade, FreeCAD, Fusion, SolidWorks, or similar) or geometric modeling libraries.
* Prior work on systems with physical-world consequences: robotics, aerospace, energy, biotech, advanced manufacturing.

**BENEFITS**

We offer health, dental, and vision insurance

**LOCATION & WORK POLICY**

This role is fully in person in Austin, Texas. Our facility is located next to Austin Airport.

Founded in 2021, Parspec is revolutionizing the materials supply chain for the $13 trillion USD construction industry by digitizing and organizing the industry's product data. Our proprietary AI technology maintains a current and comprehensive catalogue of millions of products, enabling our customers to identify products that best meet their needs–instantly. Join us in building transformative technology that reshapes one of the world’s oldest and largest industries.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We’re seeking an Applied AI Engineer Intern to join Parspec. This role is part of the AI team and works closely with Product and Engineering on fast-moving, real-world applications of AI.

As an intern, you’ll apply modern AI and machine learning techniques to concrete product problems, such as understanding product specifications, improving product recommendations, and exploring early agentic AI workflows, while learning how AI systems are designed, built, evaluated, and shipped in the real world.

This is an ideal role for a student who wants hands-on experience applying AI to complex, messy industry data and customer-facing product workflows.

 - Analyze structured and unstructured data (e.g., product specifications, documents, metadata) to improve model performance

 - Document assumptions, results, and learnings to support cross-functional alignment and decision-making

Construction remains one of the world’s largest and least digitized industries. Parspec applies AI to power workflows that help stakeholders evaluate products, surface better options, and act with confidence.  - Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning to real-world projects, including working with imperfect data, making tradeoffs, and iterating based on results

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

 - Ability to work effectively in ambiguous problem spaces with guidance and mentorship

 - Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Exposure to B2B SaaS products, especially workflow-heavy or operations-focused software

 - Interest in or exposure to construction industry workflows, including materials procurement




WHAT WE OFFER

About the role

Scale's Global Public Sector team uses AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build AI that runs inside production systems used by national health and government organisations.

You'll own scoped components of those systems, such as a model integration, agent tool, API, data pipeline, or evaluation, from implementation through to delivery. Senior engineers set the system-level design and client commitments, so you can go deep on making your components work reliably on real data.

What you'll do

- Own the implementation, testing, and delivery of defined AI components within an established system design

- Build agent tools, model integrations, and the backend services and APIs they depend on

- Run and extend evaluations within an established framework, interpret results, investigate common failure modes, and flag regressions

- Debug production issues in the components you own and resolve them using the team's engineering practices

- Communicate progress and blockers early, and take responsibility for delivery dates within your scope

- Work directly with client teams on the requirements and feedback for your components

- Share what you learn with the team as you build public sector domain expertise

What we look for

- Experience building and shipping production software, with proficiency in Python and working knowledge of at least one of TypeScript, Java, or C++

- Hands-on experience integrating models or AI/ML components into a production application, such as calling LLMs, building retrieval or agent tooling, or deploying a trained model

- A working understanding of ML evaluation: how to read results, spot regressions, and identify common causes of model failure

- Experience owning a defined piece of work through testing, release, and production debugging

- Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to iterating on models and datasets

- Clear written and verbal communication, including raising blockers and trade-offs early

Nice to have

- A backend or full-stack engineering background, so you can work across the API, service, and data-schema layers of the systems you contribute to

- Experience with cloud ML platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

- Exposure to agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, or context engineering

- Experience handling regulated or sensitive data

Where this role sits

Your primary accountability covers production AI behaviour, its backend integration, and the evaluation required for a specific customer. Senior Full-Stack Engineers own the complete user-facing application and its infrastructure. ML Research Engineers lead novel agent architecture and the benchmark methodology used across accounts. The roles work together on agents and evaluation, with accountability set by the scope of the problem.
